name: context-ring
title: Context Ring
description: How full a chat's working memory is: a still 10px ring and its share in the composer's meta line, primary from 75%, the warning ink from 90%, opening its ContextPanel on hover, focus or click.

meta.whenToUse: Show how much of a chat's working window the last request used, in ComposerMeta's context slot.
meta.whenNotToUse: Upload or task progress (Progress, UploadPanel), or money and run cost (RunUsage).
